verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              योगक्षेमो हि राष्ट्रस्य राजन्यायत्त उच्यते। योगक्षेमो हि राज्ञो हि समायत्तः पुरोहिते॥१॥
verses.english: Shuka said O illustrious one, O foremost of Rishis, once again describe to me fully the subject bearing on soul. Tell me what, in deed, is spiritual topic and whence does it come?

verses.sanskrit: यत्रादृष्टं भयं ब्रह्म प्रजानां शमयत्युत। दृष्टं च राजा बाहुभ्यां तद्राज्यं सुखमेधते॥२॥
verses.english: Vyasa said That, O son, which is considered as spiritual with reference to human beings, I shall now mention to you, and listen to the explanation I give.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मुचुकुन्दस्य संवादं राज्ञो वैश्रवणस्य च॥३॥
verses.english: Earth, water, light, wind, and entities are the great principles which form the component parts of all creatures, and though really one are yet considered different like the waves of the Ocean.

verses.sanskrit: मुचुकुन्दो विजित्येमां पृथिवीं पृथिवीपतिः। जिज्ञासमानः स्वबलमुपेयादलकाधिपम्॥४॥
verses.english: Like a tortoise extending out its limbs and withdrawing then again, the great elements, by living in innumerable small forms, go through transformations.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा राक्षसानसृजत्तदा। ते बलान्यवमृद्गन्त मुचुकुन्दस्य नैर्ऋताः॥५॥
verses.english: All this universe of mobile and immobile objects has for its component parts these five elements. Everything, regarding creation and destruction, is referable to this fivefold elements.

verses.sanskrit: स हन्यमाने सैन्ये स्वे मुचुकुन्दो नराधिपः। गर्हयामास विद्वांसं पुरोहितमरिन्दमः॥६॥
verses.english: These five elements are in all existent things. The Creator of all things, however, has made an unequal distribution of those elements for serving different ends.

verses.sanskrit: तत उग्रं तपस्तप्त्वा वसिष्ठो धर्मवित्तमः। रक्षांस्युपावधीत्तस्य पन्थानं चाप्यविन्दत॥७॥
verses.english: How can one understand that unequal distribution in the various objects of the universe? Which amongst them are the senses and which the attributes? How may this be understood?

verses.sanskrit: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा मुचुकुन्दमदर्शयत्। वध्यमानेषु सैन्येषु वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥८॥
verses.english: Vyasa said I shall explain this to you properly, one after another. Listen with rapt attention to the subject as I explain how what I have said actually takes place.

verses.sanskrit: धनद उवाच। बलवन्तस्त्वया पूर्वे राजानः सपुरोहिताः। न चैवं समवर्तन्त यथा त्वमिह वर्तसे॥९॥
verses.english: Sound, the sense of hearing, and all the cavities within the body,-these three Originate-from ether. The vital airs, the action of the limbs, and touch are the attributes of the wind.

verses.sanskrit: ते खल्वपि कृतास्त्राश्च बलवन्तश्च भूमिपाः। आगम्य पर्युपासन्ते मामीशं सुखदुःखयोः॥१०॥
verses.english: From eyes and the digestive fire within the stomach, originate from light. Taste, tongue, and all the humours,—these three originate from water.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यस्ति बाहुवीर्यं ते तद्दर्शयितुमर्हसि। किं ब्राह्मणबलेन त्वमतिमात्रं प्रवर्तसे॥११॥
verses.english: Scent, nose, and the body,-these three,-form the attributes of earth. These then, as I have explained to you, are the changes of the five (great) elements in connection with the senses.

verses.sanskrit: मुचुकुन्दस्ततः क्रुद्धः प्रत्युवाच धनेश्वरम्। न्यायपूर्वमसंरब्धमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वचः॥१२॥
verses.english: Touch is said to be attribute of the wind; taste of water; form of light. Sound originate from ether, and scent is the property of earth.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रमिदं सृष्टमेकयोनि स्वयम्भुवा। पृथग्बलविधानं तन्न लोकं परिपालयेत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Mind, Understanding, and Nature,—these three, originate from their own previous states, and acquiring a position higher than the attributes, do not get over those attributes.

verses.sanskrit: तपो मन्त्रबलं नित्यं ब्राह्मणेषु प्रतिष्ठितम्। अस्त्रबाहुबलं नित्यं क्षत्रियेषु प्रतिष्ठितम्॥१४॥
verses.english: As the tortoise extends its limbs and withdraws them once again within itself, so the Understanding creates the senses and once again withdraws them into itself. The consciousness of ego which arises about what is above the soles of the feet and below the crown of the head, is mainly due to the action of the Understanding.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां सम्भूय कर्तव्यं प्रजानां परिपालनम्। तथा च मां प्रवर्तन्तं किं गर्हस्यलकाधिप॥१५॥
verses.english: It is the Understanding which is transformed into the (five) attributes. It is the Understanding also which is transformed into the (five) senses with the mind for the sixth. Where the attributes when the Understanding is nowhere? are Own

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीद्वैश्रवणो राजानं सपुरोहितम्। नाहं राज्यमनिर्दिष्टं कस्मैचिद्विदधाम्युत॥१६॥
verses.english: There are five senses in man. The mind is called the sixth. The Understanding is called the seventh. The Soul is the eighth.

verses.sanskrit: नाच्छिन्दे चाप्यनिर्दिष्टमिति जानीहि पार्थिव। प्रशाधि पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां मद्दत्तामखिलामिमाम्। एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच मुचुकुन्दो महीपतिः॥१७॥
verses.english: The eyes and the other senses are for only receiving impressions of form, etc. The mind exists for doubting. The Understanding determines those doubts. The Soul is said to only see every work without mingling with them.

verses.sanskrit: मुचुकुन्द उवाच। नाहं राज्यं भवद्दत्तं भोक्तुमिच्छामि पार्थिव। बाहुवीर्यार्जितं राज्यमश्नीयामिति कामये॥१८॥
verses.english: The qualities of goodness, darkness and ignorance originate from their counterparts. These exist equally in all creatures. These are called qualities and should be known by the actions they produce.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ततो वैश्रवणो राजा विस्मयं परमं ययौ। क्षत्रधर्मे स्थितं दृष्ट्वा मुचुकुन्दमसम्भ्रमम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Regarding those actions, all such states of cheerfulness or joy, of tranquillity and purity which one becomes conscious of in one self, should be known as due to the quality of goodness.

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजा मुचुकुन्दः सोऽन्वशासद्वसुन्धराम्। बाहुवीर्यार्जितां सम्यक्क्षत्रधर्ममनुव्रतः॥२०॥
verses.english: All such states of sorrow in either the body or the mind, should be considered as due to the influence of the quality of darkness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यो धर्मविद्राजा ब्रह्मपूर्वं प्रवर्तते। जयत्यविजितामुर्वीं यशश्च महदश्नुते॥२१॥
verses.english: All such states of stupefaction whose cause cannot be deterinined (by either reason or inward light), should be known as due to the action of Ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदकी ब्राह्मणः स्यान्नित्यशस्त्रश्च क्षत्रियः। तयोर्हि सर्वमायत्तं यत्किञ्चिज्जगतीगतम्॥२२॥
verses.english: Delight, cheerfulness, joy, equanimity, contentment of heart, due to any known cause or originating otherwise, are all effects of the quality of goodness.
